knowledgeBase.question: How fast can a technician arrive for an emergency AC breakdown?
knowledgeBase.answer: Our on-call technicians arrive within 30 to 60 minutes anywhere in the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex.

knowledgeBase.question: Do you offer warranties on parts and labor?
knowledgeBase.answer: Yes, all repairs include our 1-year 100% parts and labor satisfaction guarantee.
